review_description: I spoke with Paul from Greenbuild based on browsing the solar quotes website and comparing quotes. I was very happy with his knowledge of solar and he was very happy to answer any questions.The install was done in one day and was very easy and the installers left no mess or caused any damage.They also organised smart meter installations through my retailer and provided follow up phone calls to see how the system was performing.

To say I am delighted with the Sales and Service from Greenbuild is an understatement. Dickson and his expert knowledge and Passion for Solar and renewable energy solutions was the confidence I was looking for, he knows his stuff and will give you exactly what you need. He and his team are a well oiled machine, they are a friendly happy easy going crew.  You will not be disappointed. they ticked all the boxes in making this process an easy road to Solar Heaven.Top Score 10 out of 10

Started off getting quotes through the Facebook ads that pop up only to get sales calls from unqualified salesman who were obviously on commission. Met Jason one day from Greenbuild who didn't even attempt to sell me a system, just explained everything I should consider and look into. Ended up getting a quote, great quality system and smooth from start to finish. They even took care of the meter change over and meter isolator which a lot of others don't bother with. From start to finish the system was in within a week! Absolutely phenomenal!

Fantastic installer.Paul was polite, answered all the questions I asked. Took his time to explain to me in simple English. I would highly recommend Greenbuild energy Solutions for all who want to install Solar.The installation was really good and done in time. The installers, Dylan and his team were polite, tidy, punctual and respectful. Took their time to explain to me how solar works.The customer service was terrific. Lyndsay at the office was flexible to have the installation done at the time I was not at work. They did organize the grid connection.
All through the company has been helpful, friendly and supportive; a pain free experience.They organised everything from start to finish.Great company to use,Thank you Greenbuild
Whilst my system hasn't been installed yet, Paul and Lyndsay has provided excellent customer service.
The whole experience with greenbuild from start to finish including organising the smart meter was so easy and profesonal, and could recommend them very highly, a great company

Greenbuild took the time to come to us, analyse our needs and put together a system that suited our needs and budget. Everything went smoothly and good communication was maintained throughout. Now to see impact on next bill!

The rep came to my house and got on my roof, he didn't rely on Google to quote.  He knew exactly what was required. Customer service was excellent and the installation team were very professional and efficient. They were a little bit more expensive for similar equipment than other quotes but I felt confident in their ability to deliver a good result. Just waiting on simply energy to install my smart meter so I can go live.

Paul was great to deal with.He worked around our needs. The installation went well, the guys were on time and did a clean job. We did wait almost 3 weeks after the installation to have our smart meter installed but the system is working fine.Great local business to deal with.

The whole process from the initial contact to quoting to communication to installation was relaxed,  smooth and efficient and everyone involved was professional, knowledgeable and personable. They provided excellent advice, with attention to detail and installed a quality, value for money system. The benefits of engaging a local company and dealing directly with the people who have a personal investment in the whole process through to the end are undeniable.The installation team were punctual, courteous, tidy and efficient, and the meter change and grid connection was all organised for the same day.Overall a good experience and we are very happy with the service and product and so, would highly recommend Greenbuild Energy Solutions.

Sales meeting went great. Dixon was very knowledgeable about what to expect from my solar system & provided some advice on multiple panels & inverters.Once installation was complete, I was blown away with how clean & tidy the system was installed. Neatly cut rails, clamps in the ideal locations, all electrical work was clean. No mess left behind.

Installation was fast, the guys were great. I was given a quote after the roof was inspected and measured, time was spent explaining everything which was one of the reasons i picked this company. They were all friendly and professional

The rep from Greenbuild was the only one that came out and did a site inspection and explained how the proposed offer would work. Consequently, I felt there was less uncertainty about the offer. The installers were prompt and provided a brief explanation of operation. Given the delay in installation of the smart meter by a few days, I had forgotten some of the inverter instructions, but worked it out.

I had a great experience with Greenbuild. I was promptly contacted by Sam after submitting my quote request and he was always responsive to my questions. My installation occured during a heatwave in the extremely busy period leading up to Christmas, and Lyndsay in the office did a great job rescheduling my installation to work around very challenging weather conditions. The guys doing the install were very courteous and put in extra effort to install the inverter where I wanted it. They worked hard in challenging conditions but still put safety first when it became too windy to continue on my two storey house. The installation is very neat and tidy and my system was pumping out the full 10 kW within minutes of it being switched on.

Quoting was informative and allows scope to make choices for you system.Install was professional and fast.Lyndsay was great, very helpful and went the extra mile to ensure we had an inverter when their supplier limited the availability of our quoted model.

I recommend Greenbuild.From Dickson's initial site inspection to the quote from Lyndsay and the installation by Con, Lucas and Jason everything went smoothly.The system is functioning as expected, we are very satisfied customers.Thanks guys!

All Four of the quotes were good according to system supplied.Difficult decision, price partly was the decider, but not entirely.All the quoters were very obliging and helpful bearing in mind our requirements.Installation will take place in the next few weeks.I would like to thank you for supplying all those firms to us.

Every staff member I dealt with was highly professional and eager to provide the best service they could. Although they did not have the panels I wanted they provided a higher quality at the same price. The installers were pleasant, courteous and very efficient. Everything ran to schedule as they planned. This company was a delight to work with. The main problem I had was with the Electricity company contractor who came to install the smart meter. After 6 weeks of waiting i was told the job was considered too difficult because of the some of the wiring behind the board being short. I called Greenbuild to ask for help. Although it was not their problem they immediately responded and came to the house on a Friday at 6pm. They assessed the situation and contacted the contractor advising the job was difficult but do-able and supported this with photographs. The meter was installed within 2 working days. I can highly recommend Greenbuild as a solar sale and installation company. I wish more companies provided such quality service.
Installation was spread out over 2 sessions start Tuesday 18/12 end Friday 21/12.Delayed smart meter application so missed 2018 new meterSmart meter not installed until 16 January.

Greenbuild came out and explained the system to us in detail, then got on our roof and did a full measure.  The system was installed in within 2.5 weeks and the meter was installed by AGL 2 days later. The price was the same as other companies that we had a quote from but Greenbuild took the time to do the job right and was the only company to offer to come to the house.  We are recommending them with confidence to our friends and family.

After receiving my 3 quotes, Greenbuild was the only company to bother to visit my house and actually get on the roof and assess the job rather than using google maps. Dickson took the time to explain which system would be best for my particular application after reviewing our power consumption over the last couple of bills.Installation of the system was delayed due to the weather,but when the time came Stuart and the lads worked tirelessly to get the job completed as the new smart meter was being installed two days later. Lastly Lyndsay who kept in touch throughout the installation to ensure all went well.Great work Greenbuild Energy....well done!!

There was a lack of information about the system after it was installed. The system was left switched off and no information on activating it. It was only after contacting Greenbuild that the tech told me about an isolator which was located under the inverter (out of sight) needed to be turned on. Also there was no user manual supplied or any follow up customere service.
Greenbuild Energy Solutions provided a very professional service. Their explanation on engineering and the solar issues that arise were very good.

Great communication, great quality product. Design to install had to change as the roof image was not to scale to the panels. I totally understood this and it was stated that things can change when installation commences. I would feel with technology of today that this could be a more accurate process.
Sorry, I cannot praise these guys high enough. Totally pleasant and professional from the start to connection. Do not hesitate dealing with them if your serious.
They gave us their word, they delivered. We were very happy with them
This would be a good supplier to include. A couple of others were similar, but the guy in charge seemed to have a good knowledge of solar and his advice was straight forward.
The only issue is we cant get the app working on the Fronius inverter. Greenfields are assisting with this. Just seems the Fronius all or system is not the easiest to set up.

It was a pleasure dealing with Lyndsay and Dickson. They were very easy to talk to and have promptly answered any questions we have had, both before and after purchasing the system. Looking forward to seeing our first bill!

Solar quotes gave me the confidence to go ahead with installing solar. Very helpful. Greenbuild Energy Solutions provided me with all the relevant information and answered my questions thoroughly as well as a good price.

Glad we chose Greenbuild energy solutions!

I hope I can sort crap from the truth and I asked for what I wanted and that is what I got, there is a lot of misinformation out there, but looking at your guide lines I was happy to pick my best system.

After taking some time & doing lots of reading & research on various options & products (THIS IS A MUST) I  had just had some initial concerns to go with a young company.  I am glad to state that  I was very happy with whole sales process & installation & now just waiting for SA Networks to install my new meter.   I can confidently recommend GreenBuild Energy Solutions

From placing the order, to the date of installation, was about two weeks, as quoted.  The system was installed and running within about 4 hours and carried out without issues.Greenbuild Energy Solutions are good people to deal with, knowing their product well.

We received a number of quotes for exactly the same panels and inverter. Greenbuild are a local company, the installation was quick, and they were the cheapest. We were asking about battery installation in addition to panels and after going through our energy usage he pointed out that the cost savings would not justify the install price. It was nice to have a local , friendly easy to deal with sales team.The installation was quick and easy and the installation team were efficient and on time/
Very prompt service and installation was very quick with no fuss.
Always prepared to answer any questions, professional and know their product.

Our system is yet to be connected to the grid but thus far, the information we have been supplied throughout this process has been in simple terms and all staff concerned have been extremely helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. Seriously!!

From the initial contact to the finished install we found the service very good. On the day of install, the installers arrived at the allotted time, and worked through until the job was complete. The are was left tidy with all rubbish taken away. At this stage (4 days after install) everything is working as promised.

The fact that Paul (salesman) called to advise the rebate had gone up and the price of the system was now much lower than first quoted. He didn't have to do that, company could have pocketed the saving, great ethical value! No one else did this.Very happy with installers, knew exactly what each had to do and just did it, very professional.

Greenbuild have proven that they are a reliable organisation.--they have done everything they said would be done on time and with splendid cooperation they have kept me in the picture with every sequence of the installation.  Would recommend them for your next project.

Solar Quotes provided 3 excellent Solar companies for us to engage with . We had a quote done by a company advertising  on TV with very cheap price. This company would not send out a person to talk face to face with us unless we paid $300 deposit to secure the advertised price. The system was installed very neatly in the desired location.  System finished off well and running very efficiently.  Good workmanship and it should pay for itself in no time at all.
